# Identify the season for the Vikings in 1976
vikings_season = 1976
# Find the season before 1976 where the NFC champion is not the Vikings
# Get the row for the season before 1976 (i.e., the previous champion)
previous_seasons = df[df['Season'] < vikings_season]
# Sort by season descending to get the most recent before 1976
previous_seasons_sorted = previous_seasons.sort_values('Season', ascending=False)
# The team from the first row (most recent season before 1976) is the answer
answer = previous_seasons_sorted.iloc[0]['Team']
